title: Search the parent company's domain when the brand's comes back empty
hypothesis: Every brand's own domain holds its marketing staff.
change: Wrote the parent domain into the row and reran the search when the brand domain returned nobody.
result: Clay people search found nobody on nocco.com or barebells.com and four people on vitaminwell.com; Barebells resolved to a buyer at the parent.
next_decision: Resolve parents first (Vitamin Well, Unilever, Celsius Holdings) and fall back automatically.
check: When a search on a brand domain returns nobody, rerun it on the parent's domain before giving up.
scope: Consumer brands owned by holding companies.
